## Load packages

`WGCNA`, `fgsea`, `ggnewscale` and `scales` are called with `::`.

```{r setup}
pacman::p_load(here, limma, dplyr, tidyr, purrr, stringr, ggplot2, patchwork, ggrepel, readr,
  readxl, writexl)
here::i_am("04_Network/02_module_traits/a_script/02_module_traits.qmd")
```

## Read inputs

The module-trait view of the YvO Figure 5 for each of the four networks from `01_modules`: the
training and between-leg contrasts, and the association of each module with muscle size and echo
intensity before training, after training and in change. Inputs: the membership, module names and
eigengene tests from `01_modules`, the protein estimates, the stage 02 fit and the phenotype table.

```{r read}
stage <- here("04_Network", "02_module_traits")
modules_book <- here("04_Network", "01_modules", "c_data", "01_modules.xlsx")
membership <- read_excel(modules_book, "membership")
module_info <- read_excel(modules_book, "modules")
eigengene_tests <- read_excel(modules_book, "eigengene_tests")
change_tests <- read_excel(modules_book, "change_tests")
proteins <- readRDS(here("01_Preprocess", "02_Quantification", "c_data", "proteins.rds"))
fit <- readRDS(here("02_Differential_Expression", "02_Differential", "c_data", "fit.rds"))
phenotype <- read_csv(here("00_Input", "phenotype.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
targets <- proteins$targets
count(module_info, network)
```

## Recompute the eigengenes

The main network removes each participant's mean, which a change keeps intact but a level loses,
so its eigengenes are recomputed on the raw abundance with the network's memberships and
between-person differences in module level stay in. The pre and post networks use their own
timepoint's samples and the change network each leg's post minus pre change, as in `01_modules`.

```{r eigengenes}
legs <- targets |>
  mutate(leg_id = paste(participant, leg, sep = "_")) |>
  select(leg_id, participant, leg, treatment, timepoint, sample_id) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = timepoint, values_from = sample_id) |>
  drop_na(T1, T2)
change <- t(proteins$E[, legs$T2] - proteins$E[, legs$T1])
rownames(change) <- legs$leg_id
pre <- targets$timepoint == "T1"
inputs <- list(
  main = t(proteins$E), change = change, pre = t(proteins$E[, pre]), post = t(proteins$E[, !pre])
)
eigengenes <- imap(inputs, function(x, name) {
  labels <- filter(membership, network == name)
  me <- WGCNA::moduleEigengenes(x, labels$module[match(colnames(x), labels$protein)])$eigengenes
  me <- as.matrix(select(me, -MEM0))
  dimnames(me) <- list(rownames(x), sub("^ME", "", colnames(me)))
  me
})
main_change <- eigengenes$main[legs$T2, ] - eigengenes$main[legs$T1, ]
rownames(main_change) <- legs$leg_id
```

## Test the phenotype associations

Each module gets one test per outcome, using both arms. Levels are regressed on the outcome with
arm as a covariate, and participant enters as a block: each person gave two legs, and
`duplicateCorrelation()` estimates how alike those two legs are so that the second counts for
less than an independent leg. Changes use the two analyses of `03_Protein_Association`, on each
leg's eigengene change against its outcome change: pooled, with one intercept per arm, and within
participant, with one intercept per participant. On per-leg changes these reproduce the slope t
of that step's sample-level designs exactly.

The test is the least-squares t on the outcome coefficient, shown as an r-equivalent,
sign(t) × √(t² / (t² + df)): the partial correlation of module and outcome given the other terms,
the same scale as the YvO figure. BH runs within each network, block and outcome across modules.
Echo intensity falls as muscle quality improves. `slope_t()` fits one design to an eigengene
matrix; `level_slopes()` and `change_slopes()` build the designs for one network.

```{r slope-t}
slope_t <- function(eigengenes, design, block = NULL) {
  correlation <- if (!is.null(block)) {
    duplicateCorrelation(eigengenes, design, block = block)$consensus.correlation
  }
  fit <- lmFit(eigengenes, design, block = block, correlation = correlation)
  t <- fit$coefficients[, "value"] / (fit$stdev.unscaled[, "value"] * fit$sigma)
  tibble(module = rownames(eigengenes), n = nrow(design), t, df = fit$df.residual,
    p = 2 * pt(-abs(t), df))
}
r_equivalent <- function(t, df) sign(t) * sqrt(t^2 / (t^2 + df))
```

```{r phenotype-tests}
outcomes <- c(vl_csa = "VL CSA", rf_csa = "RF CSA", vl_echo = "VL echo", rf_echo = "RF echo")
measured <- phenotype |>
  select(participant, leg, matches("_(pre|post)_")) |>
  pivot_longer(-c(participant, leg), names_to = c("outcome", "timepoint"),
    names_pattern = "^(.*)_(pre|post)_.*$", values_to = "value") |>
  mutate(timepoint = c(pre = "T1", post = "T2")[timepoint])
measured_change <- measured |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = timepoint, values_from = value) |>
  transmute(participant, leg, outcome, value = T2 - T1)
level_slopes <- function(me, timepoint) {
  samples <- filter(targets, sample_id %in% rownames(me), .data$timepoint == .env$timepoint)
  block <- c(T1 = "Pre", T2 = "Post")[[timepoint]]
  map(set_names(names(outcomes)), function(o) {
    data <- inner_join(samples, filter(measured, outcome == o),
      by = c("participant", "leg", "timepoint"))
    slope_t(t(me[data$sample_id, ]), model.matrix(~ treatment + value, data), data$participant)
  }) |>
    list_rbind(names_to = "outcome") |>
    mutate(block = .env$block)
}
change_slopes <- function(me) {
  map(set_names(names(outcomes)), function(o) {
    data <- inner_join(legs, filter(measured_change, outcome == o), by = c("participant", "leg"))
    bind_rows(
      Change = slope_t(t(me[data$leg_id, ]), model.matrix(~ treatment + value, data)),
      "Change within participant" = slope_t(
        t(me[data$leg_id, ]), model.matrix(~ participant + treatment + value, data)
      ),
      .id = "block"
    )
  }) |>
    list_rbind(names_to = "outcome")
}
phenotype_tests <- bind_rows(
  main = bind_rows(
    level_slopes(eigengenes$main, "T1"), level_slopes(eigengenes$main, "T2"),
    change_slopes(main_change)
  ),
  change = change_slopes(eigengenes$change),
  pre = level_slopes(eigengenes$pre, "T1"),
  post = level_slopes(eigengenes$post, "T2"),
  .id = "network"
) |>
  mutate(r = r_equivalent(t, df), padj = p.adjust(p, "BH"), .by = c(network, block, outcome))
phenotype_tests |>
  summarise(tests = n(), nominal = sum(p < 0.05), expected = 0.05 * n(), bh = sum(padj < 0.05),
    .by = c(network, block))
filter(phenotype_tests, padj < 0.05) |> arrange(network, padj)
```

## Contrasts as correlations

The contrast columns convert each eigengene t from `01_modules` to the same r-equivalent: the five
stage 02 contrasts for the main network, and the per-arm training means and their paired
difference for the change network. The difference of the training changes is the BFR × Time
interaction, so it shares that label.

```{r contrasts}
contrast_label <- c(
  "BFR_Post-Pre" = "Tr. BFR", "HLRT_Post-Pre" = "Tr. HLRT",
  "Modality_x_Time_Interaction" = "BFR × Time", "BFR_Pre-HLRT_Pre" = "Pre",
  "BFR_Post-HLRT_Post" = "Post",
  "BFR training" = "Tr. BFR", "HLRT training" = "Tr. HLRT", "BFR - HLRT" = "BFR × Time"
)
contrast_cells <- bind_rows(
  main = rename(eigengene_tests, test = contrast),
  change = change_tests,
  .id = "network"
) |>
  transmute(
    network, module, column = contrast_label[test], t, df, p, padj = fdr, kind = "contrast",
    block = if_else(test %in% c("BFR_Pre-HLRT_Pre", "BFR_Post-HLRT_Post"), "BFR vs HLRT",
      "Training"),
    r = r_equivalent(t, df)
  )
cells <- phenotype_tests |>
  mutate(column = outcomes[outcome], kind = "phenotype") |>
  bind_rows(contrast_cells) |>
  mutate(
    column = factor(column, unique(c(contrast_label, outcomes))),
    stars = case_when(padj < 0.001 ~ "***", padj < 0.01 ~ "**", padj < 0.05 ~ "*", .default = ""),
    strip = if_else(kind == "phenotype", paste0(block, "\nn = ", n), block)
  )
```

## Draw the heatmaps

One page per network. Purple and green show the contrasts, red and blue the phenotype
associations. A solid outline marks BH p < 0.05 with stars, a dashed outline nominal p < 0.05, and
bold text |r| ≥ 0.40. The left bar gives each module's size, labelled with its BH-enriched top set
(or "no set" when none passes) and its hub protein. `module_heatmap()` draws one network's page.

```{r heatmap}
block_order <- c("Training", "BFR vs HLRT", "Pre", "Post", "Change", "Change within participant")
module_info <- module_info |>
  mutate(
    colour = WGCNA::labels2colors(as.integer(sub("M", "", module))),
    term = str_trunc(str_to_sentence(str_replace_all(
      str_remove(top_set, "^.*\\|([A-Z]+_)?"), "_", " "
    )), 32),
    label = paste0(module, ": ", coalesce(term, "no set"), " | ", hub)
  )
module_heatmap <- function(name, title) {
  info <- filter(module_info, network == name) |>
    arrange(desc(as.integer(sub("M", "", module)))) |>
    mutate(module = factor(module, module))
  data <- filter(cells, network == name) |>
    mutate(
      module = factor(module, levels(info$module)),
      strip = factor(strip, unique(strip[order(match(block, block_order))]))
    )
  heatmap <- ggplot(data, aes(column, module)) +
    geom_tile(data = filter(data, kind == "contrast"), aes(fill = r), colour = "white") +
    scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#1b7837", mid = "white", high = "#762a83", limits = c(-0.8, 0.8),
      oob = scales::squish, name = "r-equivalent (contrasts)") +
    ggnewscale::new_scale_fill() +
    geom_tile(data = filter(data, kind == "phenotype"), aes(fill = r), colour = "white") +
    scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#2166ac", mid = "white", high = "#b2182b", limits = c(-0.8, 0.8),
      oob = scales::squish, name = "r-equivalent (phenotype)") +
    geom_tile(data = filter(data, padj < 0.05), fill = NA, colour = "black", linewidth = 0.5) +
    geom_tile(data = filter(data, padj >= 0.05, p < 0.05), fill = NA, colour = "black",
      linewidth = 0.3, linetype = "dashed") +
    geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.2f", r), fontface = if_else(abs(r) >= 0.4, "bold", "plain")),
      size = 1.6) +
    geom_text(aes(label = stars), size = 1.6, nudge_y = 0.3) +
    facet_grid(~strip, scales = "free_x", space = "free_x") +
    labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 6) +
    theme(
      panel.grid = element_blank(), axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      axis.text.y = element_blank(), strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
      legend.position = "bottom"
    )
  size_bars <- ggplot(info, aes(sqrt(proteins), module)) +
    geom_col(aes(fill = colour), width = 0.7, colour = "grey30", linewidth = 0.2) +
    scale_fill_identity() +
    scale_x_reverse(breaks = sqrt(c(10, 50, 200, 400)), labels = c(10, 50, 200, 400)) +
    scale_y_discrete(labels = set_names(info$label, info$module)) +
    labs(x = "proteins", y = NULL) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 6) +
    theme(panel.grid = element_blank())
  size_bars + heatmap + plot_layout(widths = c(0.8, 4)) + plot_annotation(title = title)
}
heatmap_pages <- list(
  module_heatmap("main", "Main network: module-trait associations"),
  module_heatmap("change", "Change network: module-trait associations"),
  module_heatmap("pre", "Pre-training network: module-trait associations"),
  module_heatmap("post", "Post-training network: module-trait associations")
)
```

## Draw the scatters

For the main network, the left scatter places each module by its fgsea NES in the two training
contrasts, with the module's proteins as the set and the stage 02 moderated t as the ranking, as
in the YvO figure. The right scatter places each module by its eigengene r-equivalent, BFR against
HLRT, before and after training. It uses the eigengene tests rather than NES: modules are built
from proteins that move together, and fgsea, which treats proteins as independent, gives
between-leg NES near ±3 where the eigengene tests are flat. `quadrant_scatter()` takes the table,
the two columns, the axis labels and the quadrant names, clockwise from top left.

```{r scatters}
main_info <- filter(module_info, network == "main")
main_members <- filter(membership, network == "main", module != "M0")
set.seed(1)
training_nes <- map(c(BFR = "BFR_Post-Pre", HLRT = "HLRT_Post-Pre"), function(cn) {
  ranking <- sort(set_names(topTable(fit, coef = cn, number = Inf, sort.by = "none")$t,
    rownames(fit)), decreasing = TRUE)
  fgsea::fgsea(split(main_members$protein, main_members$module), ranking, minSize = 10,
    maxSize = 1000, eps = 0) |>
    as_tibble() |>
    select(module = pathway, size, NES, padj)
}) |>
  list_rbind(names_to = "arm") |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = arm, values_from = c(NES, padj)) |>
  left_join(select(main_info, module, colour), by = "module")
between_legs <- contrast_cells |>
  filter(network == "main", block == "BFR vs HLRT") |>
  select(module, column, r) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = column, values_from = r) |>
  left_join(select(main_info, module, size = proteins, colour), by = "module")
quadrant_scatter <- function(data, x, y, xlab, ylab, quadrants) {
  limit <- max(abs(c(data[[x]], data[[y]]))) * 1.15
  counts <- c(
    sum(data[[x]] < 0 & data[[y]] > 0), sum(data[[x]] > 0 & data[[y]] > 0),
    sum(data[[x]] > 0 & data[[y]] < 0), sum(data[[x]] < 0 & data[[y]] < 0)
  )
  ggplot(data, aes(.data[[x]], .data[[y]])) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey60") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey60") +
    geom_abline(linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey60") +
    geom_point(aes(size = size, fill = colour), shape = 21) +
    geom_text_repel(aes(label = module), size = 2.2, seed = 1, max.overlaps = 20) +
    annotate("text", x = limit * c(-1, 1, 1, -1), y = limit * c(1, 1, -1, -1),
      hjust = c(0, 1, 1, 0), vjust = c(1, 1, 0, 0), size = 2.2,
      label = paste0(quadrants, "\nn=", counts)) +
    scale_fill_identity() +
    scale_size_area(max_size = 6, name = "proteins") +
    coord_equal(xlim = c(-limit, limit), ylim = c(-limit, limit)) +
    labs(x = xlab, y = ylab) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 8)
}
scatter_page <- (
  quadrant_scatter(training_nes, "NES_BFR", "NES_HLRT", "NES, BFR training", "NES, HLRT training",
    c("Discordant", "Concordant up", "Discordant", "Concordant down")) /
    quadrant_scatter(between_legs, "Pre", "Post", "BFR vs HLRT before training (r-equivalent)",
      "BFR vs HLRT after training (r-equivalent)",
      c("Flipped", "Same, BFR higher", "Flipped", "Same, BFR lower"))
) +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") +
  plot_annotation(title = "Main network: training response and between-leg difference")
```

```{r write-figures}
pdf(file.path(stage, "b_reports", "02_module_traits.pdf"), width = 8.27, height = 11.69)
walk(heatmap_pages, print)
print(scatter_page)
invisible(dev.off())
```

## Save results

```{r write}
write_xlsx(
  list(
    heatmap = cells |>
      select(network, block, column, module, n, r, t, df, p, padj) |>
      arrange(match(network, names(inputs)), match(block, block_order), column,
        as.integer(sub("M", "", module))),
    module_nes = training_nes |> select(-colour)
  ),
  file.path(stage, "c_data", "02_module_traits.xlsx")
)
```
